Join CrazyTower Casino and step into a world of exciting casino entertainment! Discover thousands of online slots, live dealer games, jackpots, and sports betting on major championships. Get started with a welcome package of 500% up to CAD 21,300 + 400 Free Spins across four deposits, plus one Fortune Wheel spin. Find your favourite games, discover new releases, and explore more ways to enjoy your time at our casino.

At Crazy Tower, the fun goes far beyond spinning reels! Complete Challenges, collect Coins, exchange them for rewards, and compete in tournaments. We've also prepared exclusive offers for cryptocurrency deposits, weekly promotions, and up to 25% cashback on live casino games. Whether you're spinning popular slots, following an ice hockey match, or joining a live dealer table, there's always something worth exploring.

Casino Games

Explore thousands of games at CrazyTower and find something that matches your mood! Online slots make up the largest part of our game collection. Choose from classic three-reel machines, modern video slots, Megaways titles, cascading reels, and games packed with bonus features. Prefer traditional gameplay? Start with classic slots and familiar symbols. Looking for something different? Discover games with special symbols, multipliers, and exciting bonus rounds.

Some of the popular games available to Canadian players include Hot Step 3 Hold and Win, 3 Gods of Olympus Pot of Rush, Monster Munch Stacks, and Diamond Strike XXL. Each comes with its own theme and features, from collecting special symbols to unlocking additional prize opportunities. We regularly add new releases to our collection, while the New, Popular, and Exclusive categories make it easier to find something interesting. Selected slots also offer demo modes, allowing you to explore their features without wagering real money.

Jackpot games deserve a special mention. At Crazy Tower, you can discover slots with fixed prize pools, progressive jackpots, and special prize features. Progressive jackpots grow according to the rules of each game until the winning combination or qualifying event triggers a payout. Other jackpot games offer predetermined prizes or rewards linked to specific bonus rounds.

Ready for a change from spinning reels? Head over to our table and card games. We've brought together different versions of roulette, blackjack, baccarat, and video poker. In standard digital versions, results are determined by a random number generator, so you can play without waiting for other participants. You can also explore Scratch Cards, Keno, and other quick games with straightforward rules.

Live Casino

Enjoy the atmosphere of a real casino with our live dealer games! At CrazyTower, you can join tables hosted by professional dealers, with real cards, roulette wheels, and live-streamed action. Every round takes place in real time, allowing you to follow the game and place bets according to the rules of your chosen table. We offer different betting ranges, making it easier to find a table that suits your preferences.

Roulette fans can enjoy European and American versions alongside special variations featuring multipliers and additional game mechanics. Our live blackjack selection includes traditional tables and alternative rules. Prefer baccarat? Choose between classic and faster-paced rounds, with bets on the Player, Banker, or Tie. We also offer live poker games where each hand is dealt by a real dealer.

Looking for something more energetic? Discover our Game Shows! These games combine familiar casino mechanics with the excitement of television-style entertainment. Prize wheels, multipliers, and special rounds create a different experience from traditional card tables. Available titles include Crazy Time, Dream Catcher, and Monopoly, each featuring its own rules and bonus opportunities.

Sportsbook

Cheer on your favourite teams with Crazy Tower! Our Sportsbook covers hundreds of sporting events every day, from major international tournaments to regional championships. Follow soccer, tennis, basketball, baseball, and American football. Ice hockey is another exciting part of our selection, with betting markets covering match results and other outcomes that Canadian fans love to follow.

Our soccer betting markets go well beyond predicting the match winner. Explore totals, handicaps, corners, individual match periods, and other available outcomes. With Bet Builder, you can combine several compatible predictions from the same event into a single bet slip. Odds are available in decimal, fractional, and American formats, so you can choose whichever feels most familiar.

We've also made room for plenty of Live Betting action. Follow matches as they unfold and place wagers after the event has started. Odds update according to what's happening in the game, while available live streams let you watch the action as it happens. Live wagers may be subject to a short acceptance delay, and the odds can change before a bet is confirmed.

Beyond team sports, our Sportsbook includes horse racing from different countries. Browse upcoming races, explore the available markets, and combine selections where permitted. We've also prepared dedicated sports promotions, including first-deposit offers, regular reload bonuses, and special incentives for cryptocurrency betting.

Halloween

Discover spooky adventures at CrazyTower with our Halloween-themed slots! Mysterious characters, eerie settings, and unusual bonus features bring a different atmosphere to every spin. Among our newer titles, you can try Spooky Step, a Halloween-inspired game featuring colourful ghost symbols. Explore more slots with haunted castles, fantasy creatures, and supernatural adventures.

We regularly refresh our game collection, so Halloween fans can discover themed entertainment throughout the year. Pick a slot, explore its features, and enjoy the mysterious atmosphere behind every spin.

Challenges

Turn your regular gaming sessions into a series of exciting missions! At Crazy Tower, our Challenges give you the chance to complete special tasks, collect Coins, and unlock additional rewards. Every mission has its own objective, allowing you to work through different challenges and discover new ways to enjoy our casino.

We offer two main types of Challenges. One-Time Challenges include individual missions linked to deposits, gaming activity, and tournament participation. Weekly Casino Challenges refresh every week and feature 28 separate tasks. Complete at least 20 during the week to receive additional Coins. The number of Coins awarded for individual missions depends on their requirements and difficulty.

Spend your collected Coins in our Shop, where you can exchange them for bonus funds, Free Spins, Free Bets, and Fortune Wheel spins. Bonus cash rewards range from the equivalent of €5 to €300, with the exact amount depending on the available reward and account currency. Each item has its own price in Coins, allowing you to save for a bigger reward or redeem smaller offers along the way.

Another exciting feature is the Wheel of Fortune. Exchange your Coins for spins and discover randomly awarded bonus prizes. We also run tournaments where players compete for leaderboard positions and rewards. In Collections, you can gather special cards and receive bonus funds according to the rules of each collection. These activities add another dimension to the gaming experience beyond individual bets and spins.

Crypto Casino

Use cryptocurrency for deposits and discover dedicated offers at CrazyTower! We support Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Solana, BNB, Dogecoin, Cardano, TRX, and stablecoins such as USDT and USDC. Selected tokens can be transferred through different blockchain networks, including ERC20, TRC20, BEP20, and Solana. This gives you several ways to make transactions using a compatible crypto wallet.

We've prepared a 200% bonus up to 4,000 USDT for your first cryptocurrency deposit. After your initial deposit, you can explore the Crypto Weekly Reload Bonus of 60% up to 1,000 USDT or the Weekend Crypto Reload Bonus of 75% up to 750 USDT + 100 Free Spins. Sports bettors can also access dedicated crypto offers, including a 100% welcome bonus up to 200 USDT and regular reload promotions.

Cryptocurrency transactions are handled through our casino cashier. For most supported coins, the minimum withdrawal is equivalent to CAD 35, while the upper limit for a single transaction generally reaches CAD 8,000. Bitcoin has a separate withdrawal range of CAD 90 to CAD 10,000. Always select the correct blockchain network and wallet address when making a transfer, as confirmed blockchain transactions generally cannot be reversed.

VIP Elite

Discover more benefits with our VIP Elite Society! At Crazy Tower, we've created a loyalty program for players who regularly return to our games. The program follows a tier-based structure, where continued gaming activity can help you progress through different statuses and access corresponding rewards.

VIP Elite Society benefits depend on your current membership level. As you move through the program, additional privileges may become available according to the conditions of each tier. The rewards offered and the requirements for reaching the next status are determined by the rules of the relevant VIP level.

Bonuses and Promotions

Start your journey at CrazyTower with a welcome package of 500% up to CAD 21,300 + 400 Free Spins across four deposits! We've divided the package into several stages, giving you the opportunity to receive additional rewards with each qualifying deposit. The welcome offer also includes one Fortune Wheel spin, available under the promotion's terms.

The amount that can be transferred from bonus funds to your real-money balance is capped at 10 times the original bonus amount. There's more to enjoy after the welcome package. Our regular promotions include a Weekly Reload with 60 Free Spins, a Weekend Reload with bonus funds and 80 Free Spins, Daily Cashback of up to 15%, and Live Cashback of up to 25%. Reward limits depend on the promotion and account currency, so the applicable maximum is displayed in the relevant offer's terms.

Live casino games, video poker, and Plinko contribute 10%, while standard table and card games do not contribute towards wagering. Jackpot slots, Bingo, and Slingo cannot be played with bonus funds. Additional restrictions may apply to specific games.

Choose the promotions that match your interests and discover new rewards in our Promotions section. Each offer has its own validity period, wagering requirements, and conditions for using bonus funds.

Registration and Login

Create your personal account at Crazy Tower and get access to our casino features! Select Register, complete the registration form, and enter your accurate personal information. Each player may have only one account. Creating duplicate accounts, using another person's details, or transferring account access to someone else is prohibited under our rules.

Once registered, select Login and enter your account credentials. You can access our casino games and Sportsbook through a browser on your computer, smartphone, or tablet. There's no need to install a separate mobile application. To keep your account secure, choose a unique password and never share your login details with anyone.

Identity verification may be required while using your account. We may request a government-issued identification document, proof of residential address, or documents confirming your payment methods. Requested verification materials must be provided within 30 days of the relevant request.

Deposits and Withdrawals

Fund your CrazyTower account using convenient payment methods and manage withdrawals directly from the cashier. For Canadian players, we support Interac, bank transfers, payment cards, Skrill, and a wide range of cryptocurrencies. Available methods depend on the type of transaction. You can check your account currency, review the applicable limits, and select your preferred payment option in the cashier.

Interac withdrawals range from CAD 10 to CAD 3,000 per transaction. Card withdrawals are available from CAD 20 to CAD 4,300, while bank transfers and Skrill support amounts between CAD 20 and CAD 7,800. Cryptocurrency withdrawals have separate limits depending on the coin and network. We process withdrawal requests according to our payment rules and internal verification procedures.

Before withdrawing, deposited funds must be wagered at least once. If this requirement has not been met, additional restrictions or fees may apply. We may also request identity verification, proof of funds, or confirmation of your payment method. You can have up to three active withdrawal requests at the same time.

Withdrawal limits in CAD depend on your account status. Beginner members can withdraw up to CAD 750 per day and CAD 10,500 per month. Amateur members have a daily limit of CAD 750 and a monthly limit of CAD 15,000. Professional members can withdraw up to CAD 1,200 per day and CAD 18,000 per month. These statuses are determined by gaming activity over the previous 90 days and may change according to our casino rules.

Withdrawal requests are processed by our finance department within three business days of submission or the last payment, provided all relevant conditions and verification requirements have been satisfied. The time it takes for funds to reach your account depends on the chosen payment method. We also perform transaction checks to help protect player funds and personal information.

mainEntity.name: Can I use multiple bonuses at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, only one bonus can be active at a time. If you activate a new promotion before completing the previous one, your current bonus and any associated winnings may be forfeited. Complete the requirements of your active offer before switching to another promotion.

mainEntity.name: Can I exchange Coins for real money?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coins are used to redeem rewards in our Shop. You can spend them on Free Spins, bonus funds, Free Bets, and Fortune Wheel spins. Coins themselves are not part of your withdrawable cash balance.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an active bonus?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, our rules allow active bonuses to be cancelled. If you cancel a bonus, all funds associated with that bonus balance will be forfeited. Cancellation is available through the relevant account settings or assistance options.

mainEntity.name: Can I bet on ice hockey at Crazy Tower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, ice hockey is part of our Sportsbook alongside soccer, basketball, tennis, and other sports. Available markets and odds depend on the individual match and when you place your bet.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I don't use my account for a long time?

acceptedAnswer.text: After 180 days without logging in, your account may be classified as inactive. Inactive accounts may be subject to a monthly administration fee equivalent to EUR 5, charged while sufficient funds remain in the account, according to our terms.

mainEntity.name: What responsible gaming tools are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: We support responsible gaming with deposit limits, session time controls, reminders, temporary breaks, and self-exclusion options. You can also request account closure. Real-money gaming is restricted to players who meet the legal age requirements in their jurisdiction.
